name: Default draft plan
note: Minimums are cumulative roster totals by the end of the checkpoint, not additional picks. Round 15 (defense) is intentionally absent -- see AGENTS.md.

checkpoints.name: Early Draft
checkpoints.guidance: Secure 2-3 studs at RB/WR, at least one of each. Lean RB.

checkpoints.name: RB Deadzone
checkpoints.guidance: Elite QB/TE only if stack synergy is available or they are falling far past ADP. Otherwise keep hammering RB/WR.

checkpoints.name: Flex Filler
checkpoints.guidance: Fill in TE if you do not have one yet, without overpaying. Prioritise best available RB/WR value, leaning WR. Do not overpay for QB/TE depth yet.

checkpoints.name: WR Cliff
checkpoints.guidance: Stack QB or TE if you do not have both. High-upside RB backups. Exactly one WR dart (rookie or role-shift in a strong offense). Optionally add one upside QB or TE.
